summary: Iter-10 regression sweep on VEYRON NOIR + WYNETTE'S PALETTE + UNCLE JO. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass — Veyron 4 tiers diff=0, Battenti control diff=0, Wynette 3 tiers diff=0 (probe-validated), UNCLE JO new 4 sampled tiers all validate (1100/1450/3900/5400), Veyron+UncleJo mixed cart validates, wrong-price still rejected. Veyron Noir frontend: hero is <video data-testid='vn-hero-video'> with autoplay/loop/muted/playsInline=true, controls=false; vn-hero-img count=0; hero.mp4 HTTP 200 video/mp4; video.paused=true / readyState=0 in headless Chromium (known H.264 limitation — PASS by network+DOM). vn-hero-cta removed (count=0), vn-add-to-cart count=1. Desktop wrap aspect '1 / 1' transform 'none'; mobile (390x844) wrap aspect 'auto' transform 'matrix(1.3, 0, 0, 1.3, 0, 0)' — exactly per spec. All 10 archive cells render. Section order monotonic Hero→Archive→Specs→Configurator→FinalWord. Default gold14k=$5,000 USD; all 4 metal price swaps exact match. Ring 9.5 default, options 8-13. ATC gold14k/9.5 and silver/11 both persist correct sku/tierKey/variant. Cart drawer opens via [data-testid='cart-button'], shows items and subtotal correctly. Wynette: 10 cells, order correct, ring default=7 ✓, ATC works. UNCLE JO page mounts at /uncle-jo and /products/uncle-jo. All 6 product routes return HTTP 200. ZERO console errors, ZERO 404s across all pages tested. HOWEVER two HIGH-priority issues surfaced: (1) WYNETTE'S PALETTE FRONTEND/BACKEND PRICE MISMATCH — UI configurator shows silver $2,000 / gold10k $6,000 / gold14k $8,000 (default), but backend /api/validate-cart returns server_price 2950/7950/10600 with valid=false 'Price mismatch detected'. Cart items persist lockedPriceCad=8000 which will be REJECTED at checkout. Also Wynette price is rendered WITHOUT 'USD' suffix while Veyron renders 'USD'. (2) UNCLE JO IS MISSING FROM /shop PAGE — user expected it as first card with 'From $1,100 USD' but searching shop body for 'UNCLE JO' / 'Uncle Jo' / 'UNCLE' returns nothing. The $1,100 visible on /shop belongs to 'The Carapace', not Uncle Jo. /uncle-jo page itself works.

critical.issue: Server price (silver=2950, gold10k=7950, gold14k=10600) DOES NOT MATCH frontend display (2000/6000/8000). Cart will be rejected at checkout for every Wynette purchase. Frontend pricing source diverged from backend pricing_engine.py.

rca_of_the_issue: Wynette price mismatch: frontend /app/frontend/src/data/livePricingConfig.js wynettePalette tiers or the useLiveTierPrices hook calculates a different USD figure than /app/backend/pricing_engine.py PRICE_MIRROR['wynettePalette']. Reproduction: open /wynette-palette → configurator → note silver $2,000 / gold10k $6,000 / gold14k $8,000 → curl POST /api/validate-cart with those USD values → all three return valid=false with server_price 2950/7950/10600 and a $950/$1,950/$2,600 difference. Mitigation: pick one source of truth (recommend backend) and either (a) have FE call /api/probe-price (or /api/validate-cart with client_price=0) on mount to populate the configurator, or (b) hard-code matching tier prices in both files.
